title: Literally
summary: LIT'ERALLY, adverb 1. According to the primary and natural import of words; not figuratively. A man and his wife cannot be literally one flesh. 2. With close adherence to words; word by word. So wild

inlines.v: LIT'ERALLY, adverb 1. According to the primary and natural import of words; not figuratively. A man and his wife cannot be literally one flesh. 2. With close adherence to words; word by word. So wild and ungovernable a poet cannot be translated literally
